source: I want a soccer game with bots to play if there's no one to play with I want spawn to be a field with a world cup trophy in the middle of spawn then I want a shop so you can buy celebrations and dance then I want a goalkeeper to guard the goal. then I want rounds of 32,16 quarter final semi finals and then finals. If there is a tie it goes to penalty shootout up to 5 tries to win. Then I was a crowd around the stadium and hear cheering for the teams I want to have a flag pick between France Spain Portugal Argentina New Zealand America Canada Morocco Cape Verde Brazil England Uruguay Croatia Germany Norway. You can choose between any team and swap at any time not in the middle of gameplay though. then I want a shop so people can buy a flag to play 2,500 for Argentina 2,500 for other countries. You earn 250 in game coins for every win. Everytime you goal 10 coins. I want a cheer for the winner of the final. And a flag of Spain for them winning the 2026 world cup.

image_prompt.text: Painted touchlines and goal lines marking the edge of live play on the pitch
Centre circle kickoff spot and penalty spots the ball resets to between matches and for shootouts
Two goal mouths at either end of the pitch, one of them guarded
Pitch markings - centre line, penalty box, corner arcs - painted into the turf
Tiered stands filled with a crowd ringing the pitch on all four sides
Stadium wall closing the bowl off behind the stands and keeping the ball in play
A World Cup trophy on a pedestal in the middle of the spawn field
A shop building beside the stadium selling celebrations, dances, and country flags
A large flag of Spain raised for the winner of the final

layout_placement.text: Detection perimeter along the touchlines so play pauses the moment the ball leaves the pitch
Static reset positions at the centre circle and the penalty spot for kickoff and shootouts
Goal-mouth detection volumes registering a goal when the ball crosses the line
A spawn field where players arrive, centred on the trophy
A goalkeeper posted in the goal mouth to guard it

notes: Bleachers are tiered relief with no overhang, so the stand height has to be captured or the stadium builds flat.
A regulation pitch is a fixed spec, so parametric placement beats free image generation for the field itself.
Most of this prompt is not layout: tournament rounds, coin prices and rewards, flag ownership, bots, and cheering audio have no home in the handoff.

open_questions.ask: Should the stadium read as a real modern World Cup venue, or stylized and cartoonish?
Is the pitch regulation size with full stands, or a compact arcade-sized pitch?

theme: Modern real-world football stadium, broadcast-match look

answers.ask: Should the stadium read as a real modern World Cup venue, or stylized and cartoonish?
answers.answer: Use a real modern World Cup-style stadium, with a large crowd, national flags, and the Spain 2026 winner presentation.

answers.ask: Is the pitch regulation size with full stands, or a compact arcade-sized pitch?
answers.answer: Use a compact arcade-sized pitch with full stands so rounds are quick and easy to play.
